name: Downtown no Gaki no Tsukai ya Arahende!!
description: A Japanese variety show hosted by popular Japanese owarai duo, Downtown, with comedian Hōsei Tsukitei (formerly known as Hōsei Yamasaki) and owarai duo Cocorico co-hosting.

videos.title: 24-Hour TagOnigokko
videos.overview: A batsu game that took place over the period of 24 hours where all the cast, except Matsumoto, are locked in a sports arena, playing "tag" with various Oni (demons) (who, here,—except for two or three instances {that were on film},—were men dressed in full-body black suits) that were "summoned" to attack at random moments, each with a specific type of punishment written on the suit to be inflicted whenever the victims were tagged. This batsu game is the result of Matsumoto winning the race against the four others in "Gaki no tsukai - 4 tai 1 100m sou Taiketsu!" (on Oct. 17, 1999).

videos.title: Haunted Hotel
videos.overview: After Matsumoto loses a swimming match (match aired on Feb. 11, 2001) against the other four cast members, a batsu game is set at a "haunted ryokan", where Matsumoto must remain overnight. He endures ghost apparitions, a seemingly empty samurai suit that comes alive, and random knocks on walls, among other things. The other four cast members attend to support him in controlling his fear, but end up scaring him as well.

videos.title: No-Reaction Pie Hell
videos.overview: In this game, Matsumoto is punished for losing a bet (bet aired on Oct. 27, 2002) with Hamada over the 2002 Japan Series. In their bet, Hamada picked the Yomiuri Giants while Matsumoto picked the Seibu Lions; the Giants won the series four games to none. Matsumoto's punishment was having to spend a day at home while Hamada, Endō, Tanaka and Yamasaki threw pies at him (after showering and in bed) and everything he touched (including a television set and a toaster), non-stop. Matsumoto had to ignore all of this while following prompts from a narrator over the sound-system.

videos.overview: A Hamada Bamyu Bamyu special summarizing how the persona was created and the things that happened afterwards.

videos.title: #1287 - Endo Verification Dokkiri
videos.overview: The gang being shown a VTR that was cut from the no-laughing batsu, taken of Endo and some strange behavior he was showing when recording for a different show.

videos.title: #1288 - 100 Questions Saito Takumi (Part 1)
videos.overview: This week is the 100 Questions segment and the guest for this week is actor Saito Takumi, who made his big break a couple of years ago and is now starring in the new drama airing before Gaki no Tsukai this week.

videos.title: #1289 - 100 Questions Saito Takumi (Part 2)
videos.overview: We finish off last week's 100 Questions segment with Saito Takumi and as always there is a reward from the guest at the end for the victor.

videos.title: #1290 - 27th New Year's Party
videos.overview: The annual New Year's Party episode is up, as well as the annual Yama-1 Grand Prix, the 10th edition this year. Who will impress the most?

videos.title: #1291 - Costume Talk
videos.overview: The first Costume Talk for the year features the gang discussing their families' reactions while they watched the recent No Laughing special together, some apparent fortunetelling predicting many things for the gang in 2016, including that Hosei will return to competing in 'that famous battle' and a discussion on the future of Hamada Bamyu Bamyu.

videos.title: #1292 - Jimmy Onishi Long Interview (Part 1)
videos.overview: The third in the 24 hour long interview series (previously done by Hosei and Drunk Dragon's Suzuki), this week features one of the favorites of Gaki and former cast member Jimmy Onishi. Always a staple of the No Laughing series, Jimmy has been making more frequent appearances on regular TV, including a guest spot on Suiyoubi no Downtown last year. Having graduated from the show in February of 1996 to pursue his painting career, this marks the first time in 20 years since he last appeared on a weekly episode of the show.

videos.title: #1293 - Jimmy Onishi Long Interview (Part 2)
videos.overview: Continuing on from last week, we see the second half of Jimmy Onishi's 24 hour interview.

videos.title: #1294 - Endo's Mori Shin'ichi Dinner Show
videos.overview: Endo's Mori Shinichi character makes a return, this time being the big act at a hotel's dinner show the others are 'invited to'.

videos.title: #1295 - Best of Stroll to Meet Celebrities
videos.overview: This week features no new content; instead the staff are throwing together a 'best of' package of the Strolling to Meet Celebs series.

videos.title: #1296 - 7th I Think You Like This Item
videos.overview: The 'I Think You Like This Item' series makes its first appearance for 2016. The guest this week is Nakamura Tamao, a veteran actress who mostly interacts with Downtown through their Downtown DX show, where she is often teased for telling ridiculously long stories about her personal life.

videos.title: #1297 - Sudden Japanese Dance Competition
videos.overview: This week involves the guys trying to come up with their own renditions of traditional Japanese dancing, despite not having experience in it. They will have to do their own makeup and learn the choreography by themselves.

videos.title: #1298 - 3rd Nakamura vs Onuma
videos.overview: The 'battle' between these two producers is the theme of this week's episode. As was the case with the previous two installments, the duo compete in random contests and the members act as judges.

videos.title: #1300 - 3rd Itao's Lip-sync Song Show
videos.overview: The guys dress up as famous singers and 'sing'/lip sync some of their most known songs.

videos.title: #1301 - Rendezvous Game (Part 1)
videos.overview: This week the guys split off to various places around Tokyo without their phones. All five members are shown a theme and are challenged to think about what place or object they would associate with that theme. They must then be able to meet up with the other members of the gang at the same places. Until all five are together at the same place, the challenge does not end.

videos.title: #1302 - Rendezvous Game (Part 2)
videos.overview: Continuation from last week's episode, where we finish up the challenge with the gang.

videos.title: #1303 - Impromptu Ghost Story Inn
videos.overview: A concept proposed by Tanaka for this week's episode. Each member draws two cards randomly from a batch that has a word on it each (for example, maybe a story involving the word 'ghoul' and 'faceless') and from there, they must improvise a scary ghost story using those two words as the theme/basis.

videos.title: #1304 - Hada Keisuke KARUTA Competition
videos.overview: A return of the Kartua competition for this week, with the guest being writer/author Hada Keisuke, who won the prestigious Akutagawa Prize for rookie writers together with comedian Matayoshi Naoki of the duo Peace.

videos.title: #1305 - Hamada's Birthday Fuzakennayo Dokkiri
videos.overview: We have a special episode to commemorate Hamada's 53rd birthday party with a twist. Keen observers of Gaki will note that Hamada tends to throw around the phrase 'ふざけんなよ' quite commonly whenever someone does a dumb/stupid thing; the phrase roughly translates to 'Don't screw around/be silly'. Well this episode will test the limits of how many times he will say it, with the theme of the episode being the gang and some guests bringing in an assortment of silly presents in an attempt to make him utter the phrase.

videos.title: #1306 - Kiki Tomato Juice
videos.overview: The 39th installment of the Kiki series is tomato juice. Once again, the number of choices has been reduced from 12 to 10 for this week. Wonder how Hamada will go, given he has expressed a dislike of tomato before...

videos.title: #1307 - 6th Stroll to Meet Celebrities
videos.overview: Another edition of Strolling to Meet Celebrities, this time in Shimokitazawa, located in Setagaya, Tokyo.

videos.title: #1308 - 6th Silent Library (Part 1)
videos.overview: The legendary Silent Library series makes a return this week, 8 years after the fifth installment with movie director Mitani Koki. This time, actor and friend of Downtown Azuma Mikihisa is the guest participant.

videos.title: #1309 - 6th Silent Library (Part 2) & Extra Ghost Stories
videos.overview: This week concludes the 6th edition of Silent Library.

videos.title: #1310 - Own Way Dance Competition
videos.overview: A spinoff of the Sudden Japanese Dance Competition. This week features 5 more contemporary dances in samba, flamenco, awa odori, take no kozoku and tari dance. Each member gets one and has to do as best as he can.

videos.title: #1311 - 2nd Managers Sumo GOTTSUAN (Part 1)
videos.overview: This week marks the 2nd edition of GOTTSUAN, the sumo wrestling tournament where managers from different entertainment agencies do battle. Gaki's own Fujiwara is once again competing.

videos.title: #1312 - 2nd Managers Sumo GOTTSUAN (Part 2)
videos.overview: This week concludes the 2nd GOTTSUAN tournament. Looks like Fujiwara is once again allowed a saloon passage through to the final battle. Who will he fight? Will he win? How many times do you think he will stutter through his introduction?

videos.title: #1313 - Kano Eiko Shichi-henge
videos.overview: A new edition of Shichi Henge with the guest this week being comedian Kano Eiko, who made his first ever appearance on Gaki in the previous Manager Sumo tournament. Matsumoto mentions then that he would like to have Kano on Shichi Henge in the future so it seems like it has been approved.

videos.title: #1314 - 2nd Rendezvous Game
videos.overview: This week features the 2nd Rendezvous Game.

videos.title: #1315 - Costume Talk
videos.overview: This costume talk focuses on some complaints of Matsumoto while he was in Hawaii for summer holidays and a letter that Tanaka wrote to Endo 20 years ago that Endo found recently while searching around his private items in his home. The gang will hear this letter for the first time.

videos.title: #1316 - Absolutely Tasty Okonomiyaki (Part 1)
videos.overview:
This week it's the return of the Absolutely Tasty series, which will have its first episode in almost five years.

The theme for this episode is okonomiyaki, which has been used as an ingredient in other episodes before, but this is the first time it will be used as the base.

videos.title: #1317 - Absolutely Tasty Okonomiyaki (Part 2)
videos.overview: The conclusion to the Okonomiyaki challenge will have Matsumoto and Hosei present their dishes.

videos.title: #1318 - A cappella Singing Competition
videos.overview: This week features the Gaki crew and some celebrities with absolutely no background in music, and they have to prepare on short notice for an a cappella singing contest.

videos.title: #1319 - World Ghost Story Summit 2016
videos.overview: As per the first edition of this concept that aired on the 9th of August last year, the gang listen to guests with foreign backgrounds tell scary stories from their own home countries and the gang determine whether they are really creepy stories or just plain absurd.

videos.title: #1320 - 30 Minutes Endurance Handsome Drive
videos.overview: The gang are going out for a little drive for this week's episode with a little twist. They all have to decide on a handsome facial expression and keep their faces with the same expression for the whole 30 minutes, even during conversation. If one of them breaks their expression, the time is reset and they cannot stop until they last 30 minutes.

videos.title: #1321 - I Think This Item Will Suit You
videos.overview: This week is a mini-spinoff of the 'I Think You Will Like This Item' series; where the episodes before had certain themes like pants, shirts etc., this time there will be no particular theme: the gang will just simply present an item they think suits the guest best. And this weeks guest is Ryucheru, a young model who has made his claim to fame this year for his rather extravagant fashion sense during his appearances on TV.

videos.title: #1322 - 3rd Rendezvous Game (Part 1)
videos.overview: Another Rendezvous Game for the gang to get through this week. The usual rules apply: the five members are given a theme and must go a place that they associate best with that theme. Until all five are at the same place, the game does not end.

videos.title: #1323 - 3rd Rendezvous Game (Part 2)
videos.overview: This week concludes the 3rd Rendezvous Game from last week.

videos.title: #1324 - 3rd Hamada's Cram School
videos.overview: Hamada once again takes charge of cram school in the third edition of Hamada's Cram School, the first in two years. In case you don't remember what it's about, Hamada, with Matsumoto as his assistant, takes Hosei, Cocorico and a host of other comedians through some 'classes', consisting of strange challenges.

videos.title: #1325 - Let's Play with an Old Man
videos.overview: The five guys each have to spend some time with men older than them and see who is the most compatible couple.

videos.title: #1326 - Kiki Melonpan
videos.overview: We reach the 40th edition of the Kiki series with melon bread as the main subject for this week.

videos.title: #1327 - Location Shooting Replay Challenge
videos.overview: A new challenge for the gang this week, with the guys going on location and recording a little planned 'segment'. After finishing they then must try and replicate the exact same segment on the second and third takes without going off script or having any little incidents happen during the repeat filming.

videos.title: #1328 - 4th Liars Hotel
videos.overview: This week sees Liars' Hotel back for a fourth edition. What kind of crazy stories can the guys create?

videos.title: #1329 - Yazawa Eikichi Roleplay Battle
videos.overview: This week features the gang in a impersonation competition of legendary rockstar Yazawa Eikichi, trying to act out various 'normal' situations as Yazawa.

videos.title: #1330 - Jungle Pocket Saito Shichi-henge
videos.overview: The third Shichi Henge contestant for this year is Jungle Pocket's Saito Shinji. He's part of a young trio who are considered rising stars of Yoshimoto Kogyo.

videos.title: #1331 - Ask the Best 5 in a Strange Town (Part 1)
videos.overview: The gang have to go to cities they have not traveled to before, ask around for information regarding the best points and features about the city and then come up with a best 5 ranking of those cities. They have to travel around on foot for this segment.

videos.title: #1332 - Ask the Best 5 in a Strange Town (Part 2)
videos.overview: This week continues from where last week's episode left off as the gang continue exploring new cities they haven't visited before.

videos.title: #1333 - Costume Talk
videos.overview:
Last Costume Talk for the year, discussing a couple of stories:

Another discussion on Hosei's continued balding.

The gang's thoughts about the No Laughing Batsu Game filming.

A possible sequel for Endo's film 'Busjack', which was famously made fun of in No Laughing Prison for its poor Amazon DVD ranking two years ago.

Discussion around the new buzzwords/popular terms for the past year and how out of touch Hamada seems to be with most of them.

videos.title: #1334 - 2nd I Think This Item Will Suit You
videos.overview: This segment makes a return, this time with Suzuki Fuku, a child actor. Seems like this episode will probably bring out parental instincts in the gang, given all five now have experience.

videos.title: SP - Best of No-Laughing
videos.overview: The Gaki gang choose their favorite moments from the past ten years of No Laughing games and a couple of new details about this year's game are revealed.

videos.title: #1335 - Top 10 of 2016
videos.overview: This week, we enter the end-of-year review as the top ten moments/segments from the year are revisited.

videos.title: #1338 - 28th New Year's Party
videos.overview: The gang celebrate a new year with the usual party and Yama-1 Grand Prix. Over 700 comedians auditioned this time around.

videos.title: #1339 - Costume Talk: New Year's Episodes
videos.overview: The gang get together and discuss what happened to them through the New Year's holidays.

videos.title: #1340 - Mori Masako KARUTA Competition (Part 1)
videos.overview: This week presents a new Karuta contest, with enka singer Mori Masako as the guest. She is the ex-wife of Mori Shinichi, who we all know is Endo's favorite singer.

videos.title: #1341 - Mori Masako KARUTA Competition (Part 2)
videos.overview: The conclusion to the Mori Masako Karuta competition. Also includes a little bonus Costume Talk at the end of the episode, featuring confirmation that Endo's infamous 'Busjack' movie has finished filming its sequel.

videos.title: #1342 - 4th Rendezvous Game (Part 1)
videos.overview: This week sees the 4th Rendezvous Game take place.

videos.title: #1344 - Sunshine Saito Grand Prix
videos.overview: This episode is based off a segment of the 2016 No Laughing Game, when actor Saito Takumi did a now infamous imitation of comedian Sunshine Ikezaki and his routine. Now several lesser known celebrities attempt to replicate Saito's success by doing their own impressions. Guests include the actual Sunshine Ikezaki, film critic Arimura Kon, former boxing champion Kameda Daiki, singer and actor JOY and regular variety staple Bobby Ologun.

videos.title: #1345 - 3rd I Think This Item Will Suit You
videos.overview: The Item series makes its first appearance for 2017, with the guest this week being Matsushima Nahomi, veteran comedian formerly of the duo Othello, now having gone solo for a few years.

videos.title: #1350 - Robert Akiyama Ryuji Shichi-henge
videos.overview: We celebrate another half century of episodes with our first Shichi Henge challenger for the year: Akiyama Ryuuji of the comedy trio Robert. Also includes a little bonus section of unaired Free Talk from last week's episode.

videos.title: #1352 - 7th Silent Library
videos.overview: We have a new guest for a new edition of Silent Library, with actor Ozawa Hitoshi joining the gang.

videos.title: #1353 - Forced Laughter Tour
videos.overview: This episode requires the gang and their two guests to make up a comedic reaction on the spot when indicated and try to get the others to laugh. Also includes a Free Talk segment at the end of the episode, specifically the return of the questions sent in by viewers.

videos.title: #1354 - Ryuji 100% GP
videos.overview: Similar to the earlier episode this year that featured Sunshine Ikezaki, the gang are now judging celebrities who want to emulate the success of the gags of Akira 100% and actor Harada Ryuji in last year's No Laughing game. Also includes a little bonus Free Talk section at the end.

videos.title: #1361 - No-Reaction Challenge (Part 1)
videos.overview: Who is the man who doesn't move anything !?

videos.title: #1369 - Tanaka's New Wife Competition
videos.overview: The members are worried about Tanaka, who unfortunately became a single father about four months ago. That's why they took among themselves to present him some new candidates for a new wife. Tanaka is perplexed by this project, but they members will introduce the candidates and are saying 'If it's a woman like this, it'll be fine.' They will also show some footage from interviews with the candidates and the marriage talks. The candidates will also be shocked by the sudden marriage requests, but will it actually come to a new marriage due to Tanaka's charms?

videos.title: #1370 - Busjack Returns
videos.overview: This week's Gaki No Tsukai is "Appreciating 'Busjack Returns'". Some years ago Endo starred in the movie 'Busjack'. Since people who've watched the movie were shocked by Endo's horrible acting, it became a subject on the show. The movie's sequel "Busjack Returns" was released in theaters this July. The members talked about the possibility of Downtown appearing in the movie, as well as how few people showed up to the premiere. Now, all the members will watch the movie together! Is Endo's acting power still going strong? For each of Endo's scenes, they will react by pressing a button.

videos.title: #1372 - Matsumoto's 54th Birthday (Part 1)
videos.overview: This week's Gaki No Tsukai is "Matsumoto's 54th birthday party! Let's give him a birthday song!". The members as as well a secret guest will create a song by themselves based on what they feel about Matsumoto and sing it from their heart. What kind of song will Cocorico, Hosei and Hamada sing? And who will the unlikely secret guest be? And what will Matsumoto's reaction to the song be? The members will also tell some exciting memories from this 28 year-old show. Don't miss this chance to see the bond between the members.

videos.title: SP - Ask to the Legend Geinin
videos.overview: "Legendary" comedians will be asked questions, they absolutely have to answer, whether they'd like to or not.

videos.title: #1374 - Ask to the Legend Geinin SP Extras
#1375 - Downtown's Talk
videos.overview: This week's Gaki No Tsukai is another luxury treat! A full episode of Downtown talk. Matsumoto will talk about several worries concerning his physique. He also gets fired up about a certain unfair treatment by his wife in a certain 'location' as well as a certain grief resulting from getting older. Hamada will also talk about the curious circumstances when he got booked for the famous "Kouhaku" program. Also, the show staff have secretly planned a move against Hamada that results in an interesting story. What will happen in the end? Finally, the two will clash in an argument about each other's show business reputation!

videos.title: #1376 - 2nd Ask the Best 5 in a Strange Town (Part 1)
videos.overview: This week's Gaki no Tsukai is "Let's Ask the Best 5 in a Strange Town!" All 5 members ask local residents in a strange town for a recommended place to visit. Based on their recommendation, our members then go to those 5 best places.

videos.title: #1377 - 2nd Ask the Best 5 in a Strange Town (Part 2)
#1382 - Talk about No-Laughing Batsu
videos.overview: In this week's Gaki No Tsukai, all five members gather to talk about the recording of the Batsu Game shooting that ended just days ago. Also this year, the member's complaints about the harsh conditions of the condition have no end! Matsumoto talks about his state of mind when he leaves in the morning to go to the shooting, and also gets angry about the batsu judgement. Moreover, some statistics about the past batsu games will be revealed. The unknown story about the origin of the Thai Kick will also be revealed.

videos.title: #1383 - 4th I Think This Item Will Suit You
#1384 - Refrigerator Ingredients Battle
videos.overview: In this week's Gaki, the members participate in an interesting food battle. Each members gets allotted some ingredient from the refrigerator and have to come up with some kind of recipe on the spot. The refrigerator contains beef, chicken, pork, fish, but also other stuff the members have never used before. What will Housei's unusual dish taste like? Endo does an unbelievable mistake and Hamada uses a really strange technique. What will the final result be like?

videos.title: #1385 - Top 10 of 2017
videos.overview: As for the last 20 years, the prior manager of Downtown, Fujiwara, will present the ten best moments of Gaki of 2017.

videos.title: #1386 - No-Laughing SP Review & Preview
videos.overview: This week's Gaki is a preview for next week's batsu game special. Footage from the press conference as well as a short preview will be shown!

videos.title: #1388 - Shichi Henge - Viking Kotoge
videos.overview:
This Week's Gaki will be another installment of the Shichi Henge series.

Kotoge is aiminig for the next record! Will he be able to break it?

videos.title: #1389 - Sachiko Kobayashi Karuta
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will be another Karuta game, this time hosted by famous Japanese singer Sachiko Kobayashi.

videos.title: #1390 - 2018 New Year's Party
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will be the annual New Year's Party. To start the party off, Housei will present a certain song dressed accordingly. Like every year, there will also be the Yama-1 Grandprix, a competition where new comedian talents show off their fresh material. Many comedian have started their career here! Who will take the crown this year?

videos.title: #1391 - 2S Talk
videos.overview:
This week will again consist of just the two of Downtown talking about random things.

What happened to Matsumoto in Australia? He will also talk about his bells and muscle training and special techniques which Hamada is baffled by!

videos.title: #1392 - Ikinari Steak Marathon Part 1
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will be another revival of an older segment: the eating marathons. The members will visit Ikinari Steak locations near the Yamanote Line and eat various kinds of steak. Who of the old members has the biggest expectactions?

videos.title: #1393 - Ikinari Steak Marathon Part 2
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will consist of the second and final part of the Ikinari Steak tour. Until now they have already visited 7 branches of the restaurant chain. The members will have to continue eating delicious steaks. A luck drawing system will also be introduced. What will the member's fate be?

videos.title: #1394 - Goodbye, Tsukitei Housei
videos.overview:
We have a sad announcement. This week's episode will be a Goodbye to Tsukitei Housei.

Housei, who has been a part of Gaki since the second episode will announce his retirement from the entertainment industry.

What sad truth is Housei, who has become 50 recently, hiding? What will he tell us? We will also show his best scenes from the Gaki history.

videos.title: #1395 - Let's Play World Tabletop Game
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki's title is "Let' have fun with board games from all around the globe". The member's are perplexed by the large number of different board games from many countries. They gradually get absorbed by some of the real deepness of these games.

A combination of Luck, strategy and memory and other important elements lead to a great climax.

videos.title: #1396 - Silent Library 9
videos.overview: This time's guest player is Yoshihiko Hakamada. To welcome him, this week's installment of the Silent Library features the largest amount of punishments yet. A parade of punishments one definitely doesn't wake to take upon awaits.

videos.title: SP -  Oogiri Daigassen Special
videos.overview: A special broadcast to revive the Oogiri Daigassen Segment. Matsumoto and Miyazako head two teams and face off in original games. Girolamo and Jimmy Oonishi also make a fuss this time.

videos.title: #1398 - Oogiri Daigassen - Extra Scenes
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will consist of extra scenes from the Oogiri Daigassen Special.

videos.title: #1399 - Walking Around Best Of & Talk
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will consist of two segment. The first one will be a best of from the 'Walking Around Aimlessly Until Meeting A Celebrity' episodes. The second segment will be talk segment of Matsumoto and Hamada.

videos.title: #1400 - 1000 Yen Transvestite Meetup
videos.overview: The members have to use a maximum of 1000 Yen at a 100 Yen Shop to buy a whole transvestite outfit. Comedy Duo Viking is also taking part this time.

videos.title: #1401 - Downtown Two Man Talk
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki is another Downtown two man talk special. Matsumoto talks about a stunning encounter he had with a taxi driver.

There is also a new development in the project of finding a company to create new commercials with Hamada. Which company reached out to him and what kind of Hamada do they want to present?

videos.title: #1402 - 3rd Ask the Best 3 in a Strange Town
videos.overview: Via lottery a town has been chosen, that is not known at all for any tourist spots. But there seems to be a certain dish loved by the local people! Also a 'nightmare' will happen to Housei.

videos.title: #1403 - 3rd Ask the Best 3 in a Strange Town Part 2
videos.overview: The member will ask someone for the number one spot of the town. What is the 'illusive cherry tree'? A major accident will also happen to the show staff! During driving, the members will also participate in a singing contest of songs from the past. And who will experience great agony at the number one spot?

videos.title: #1404 - Liars' Hotel
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will remark the return of the Liars' Hotel segment after one and a half years. The members will hand each other certain ridicilous lies and all have to act like it is completely true and create stories on the spot.

Which members owns a certain legendary mount? Who can use an unbelievable power if he gets drunk?

Members will use their power of imagination to create crazy stories.

videos.title: #1405 - Improvisational Shinkigeki
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will be an improvisational Shinkigeki. Without any training or preparation, the members will try to do a Shinkigeki-like Perfomance. Each member will be handed a typical role of the Shinkigeki plays. One certain pioneer Comedian will also take part in this!

videos.title: #1406 - Future Kukki
videos.overview:
In this Week's Gaki Yaseibakudan's Kukki will come to visit the members of Gaki No Tsukai from the future and tell them all about how the future will look like.

What will the members' fate be? Who will die soon?

And finally, a surprising guest will come to make Kukki's whacky world complete!

videos.title: #1407 - 5th Lip-sync Song Show
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will be another installment of Itao's Lip-Sync Song Show.

In addition to the regular cast, special guests will join and perform their lip-syncs of famous song from the past as well.

videos.title: #1408 - 5th Lip-sync Song Show Part 2
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will be the second part of the Lip-Sync show.

The build-up reaches it climax! Due to the almost identical looks, whose impersonation of a certain rock singer will cause great laughter? Also, what is the "ghostly" lip-sync by Housei this time?

Also, that certain man will show us a ragged perfomance!

Don't miss this legendary night!

videos.title: #1409 - 2nd Let's Play World Tabletop Game
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will be the second installment of the board game meet-up.

Once again, a variety of rare board game from all over the world have been gathered.

There will be a memory-based competition to get game pieces.

Who will completely fail at a game, where one has to do certain poses based on a rhythm?

These old geezers will be in high spirits and get pretty excited!

videos.title: #1410 - 2nd Let's Play World Tabletop Game Part 2
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will be the second and last part of the Board Game meet up.

A nerve-wrecking brick-building game will lead to a very high tower!

Another strategy-based occupy game will lead to great anger from Matsumoto!

Whose clumsiness will be revealed in a certain game where one has to destroy the other team's figures?

The excitement by these old geezers won't stop!

videos.title: #1411 - Downtown's Talk
videos.overview:
Matsumoto will tell us how he always manages to stay away from having some lady scandals.

Also, he will extensively tell us his opinion about sportsmanship in the world of athletes.

He has something to say about video-based decisions.

Also, the two will try some kind of "boke"-stopping training and for some reason will sing a certain song together!

videos.title: SP - Rendezvous Game
videos.overview:
On this weekend, we will have another Special of the Rendevouz Game.

The member and two special guests (Arisu Hirose and Takanori Nishikawa) will try to meet up in Tokyo, only using code words given by the staff. Will that certain man be hindrance to all the others again? And who will bring upon a certain miracle?

videos.title: #1412 - Rendezvous Game Special Unaired Scenes
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will consist of scenes that were cut from the special that airs beforehand.

videos.title: #1413 - Kushikatsu Tanaka Marahon
videos.overview:
This Week's Gaki No Tsuka is another installment of the food chain marathon corner.

The member will visit one store of the famous Kushikatsu Tanaka chain in each of the 23 districts of Tokyo.

Since Kashikatsu is a common dish in Kansa, the member should be accustomed to it.

However, by doing a drawing, the members will also have to eat some more unusual dishes and so the chaos begins..

videos.title: #1414 - Kushikatsu Tanaka Marahon Part 2
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will be the second part of the Kushikatsu Tanaka Martahon.

Every time they move to a new location, their feeling of fulness will come to haunt the member.

Also, by using a lottery system, some member will receive certain bigger sized menu items.

By implementing a special new rule, one certain miracle will happen to that man!

Will they be able to finish their challenge?

videos.title: #1415 - Young Comedian's Games (Part 1)
videos.overview:
In this week's Gaki, the member will try out original games that have been proposed by young comedians.

These games are usually played in the green room or at drinking sessions.

Some games require quick thinking, whereas other require one to move their body.

What surprising development will lead to a miracle? And who will be the final winner?

videos.title: #1416 - Young Comedian's Games (Part 2)
videos.overview:
This weeks Gaki will be the second and last part of the Young Comedian's Original Games Special.

They will play a specific version of the Shiritori Game, where one certain word will be banned.

And one certain man will showcase a really, really different kind of game.

What kind of crazy development will occur?

videos.title: #1417 - 100 Questions Sho Ayanokoji
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will be another installment of the 100/500 Questions series. The last time

The singer Sho Ayanokoji from the famous Japanese Band "Kishidan" will answer 100 questions and the members have to guess his answer.

Questions will vary from personal ones to ones that will make you say 'Who the hell cares?".

Since his answers are really unexpected, the members will enter a hard fight.

Moreover, Ayanokoji will reveal some unknown episodes that will results in surprise & laughter

videos.title: #1418 - 100 Questions Sho Ayanokoji Part 2
videos.overview:
This week's Gaki will be the continuation of last week's 100 Questions Segment with Sho Ayanokoji.

He has thrown off the members by sometimes giving straightforwad answer and sometimes giving really surprising ones.

This time he will talk about his favorite idol.

At the end there will also be a small Downtown Talk Segment. What can you do about that crazy geezer?

videos.title: #1419 - Housei's Romantic Movie
videos.overview:
In this week's Gaki, Housei will try his hand on being a director for romantic movies. Until now he has shown his many talents, including being a music producer. And this week he said, he will try being a director!

In detail, he would like to direct one of the currently very popular romantic movies. Against their will, Housei has cast the other member in his movie. Moreover, the female parts will be played by currently very popular actresses. Their will also be funny reactions, when the cast get to see the completed master pieces.

videos.title: #1420 - Dance to be Posted on SNS
videos.overview:
In this week's Gaki, each member will secretly go into the city and will have to perform a certain dance.

The goal is to dance with a lot of energy, until their dancing is reported somewhere in the social networks.

The intense heat will prove to be a hard burden. Who will win?

videos.title: #1421 - Matsumoto 55th Birthday Special
videos.overview: This week's Gaki will be another birthday special for Matsumoto. The members, Yûichi Kimura and also Chira Junia will talk about the kindness of Matsumoto. Episodes about Matsumoto that usually wouldn't be brought up will be discussed! While Matsumoto will be very embarrassed, what is that certain man up to?
